subject: Next steps to clear PO hold — vendor tax declaration needed
body:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Marković <elena@novara.tech>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps to clear PO hold — vendor tax declaration needed

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for onboarding Novara. Quick status: finance has the PO (PO-5678) ready but it's on hold pending tax evidence. We need the completed W-8BEN-E (signed), a statement on the ultimate beneficial owners (UBO) for the entity, and confirmation that the name on the invoice/bank account matches the legal entity name on the W-8BEN-E.

Can you please:
- Attach a signed W-8BEN-E (PDF, clear signature)
- Provide a short UBO declaration (who owns >25% or how control is structured)
- Confirm the legal name you expect on the Redwood PO/invoice and the bank account name for payments

If you already have the documents, reply with attachments and we can move the PO to approval. If you expect any delays, let me know estimated timing — finance prefers to avoid creating temporary vendor records without complete tax evidence.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Vendor Onboarding | Procurement
Redwood Inference

---

From: Elena Marković <elena@novara.tech>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marija Jovic <marija@novara.tech>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 11:30:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Next steps to clear PO hold — vendor tax declaration needed

Hi Soojin,

Appreciate the note — attached are the documents you requested.
- W-8BEN-E_Novara_signed.pdf (signed by our CFO)
- Novara_UBO_declaration.pdf (short statement listing two shareholders at 60% and 40%)

A couple of clarifications: Novara Technologies is incorporated in Croatia as Novara d.o.o. The legal entity name to use on invoices is "Novara Technologies d.o.o.". Our bank account is under the same name. We do not have a US TIN; as a foreign entity we submitted the completed W-8BEN-E to certify foreign status. Please tell us if you need a corporate resolution or additional attestation.

Best,
Elena
Head of Finance Operations
Novara Technologies

Attachments: W-8BEN-E_Novara_signed.pdf (application/pdf), Novara_UBO_declaration.pdf (application/pdf)

---

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Marković <elena@novara.tech>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Next steps to clear PO hold — vendor tax declaration needed

Elena — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the attachments. I reviewed the W-8BEN-E and the UBO statement. A couple of items finance needs to clear the PO:

1) W-8BEN-E completeness: Part I is good; however the W-8 we received does not include Part XX (if claiming a Chapter 3 status) nor does it clearly indicate the FATCA chapter 4 status. Please confirm the entity classification box you checked (e.g., Corporation; disregarded entity; nonfinancial foreign entity) and whether any chapter 3 withholding exemption is claimed.

2) Payee name verification: we need the legal name on the W-8 to exactly match the commercial invoice and bank account name. You wrote "Novara Technologies d.o.o." in the email — please ensure the W-8's name field is identical. If it is not, please upload a corrected W-8.

3) Corporate authorization: for first-time international payees we require either a corporate resolution (one-page PDF) authorizing the signatory on the W-8, or a notarized letter from legal counsel. The CFO signature is acceptable if accompanied by the resolution.

If you can supply (a) a corrected W-8 with the entity classification completed, and (b) the corporate resolution, we can release PO-5678 for payment setup. If obtaining a resolution will take >5 business days, we can discuss a temporary escrow process, but that requires additional paperwork.

Happy to hop on a short call if you want to walk through the form.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Elena Marković <elena@novara.tech>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps to clear PO hold — vendor tax declaration needed

Hi all — quick internal note and next steps:

- Once Novara provides the corrected W-8BEN-E (with entity classification clearly marked) and the one-page corporate resolution authorizing the CFO as signatory, procurement will move PO-5678 from "hold" to "pending approval" and route to accounts payable.
- Soojin: please share the DocuSign link (if Novara wants to e-sign the resolution) or the expected delivery date for a scanned PDF.
- Elena: if you can get both items by Thursday (2027-06-17) we should be able to complete vendor setup and schedule the first invoice payment for the following run. If not, reply with ETA and we will note an exception in the ticket.

Elena — thanks for being responsive. Once the corrected docs are in, I'll confirm final release.

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, Global Procurement
Redwood Inference

[Attachment stub: PO-5678-redwood.pdf (application/pdf) — PO document for reference]
